in_marathi.name: Maheboob
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maheboob हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maheboob is a Hindu name with unknown origin. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mah' meaning great and 'evam' meaning also, thus meaning 'great and also' or 'majestic and powerful'.
